text: Xalq maqoliga koʻra, ilm olish nima bilan quduq qazishga oʻxshaydi?
gloss: According to the proverb, getting knowledge is like digging a well with what? — A needle: «Ilm olish — igna bilan quduq qazish». The hoe is the tempting 'sensible' tool.

text: Onam 20 ta somsa yopdi. Mehmonlar avval somsalarning yarmini, keyin qolganining ham yarmini yeyishdi. Nechta somsa qoldi?
gloss: Mum baked 20 samsas; guests ate half, then half of what was left. How many are left? — 5: 20 → 10 → 5. '0' catches those who hear 'half and half' as 'all'.

text: Ulugʻbek, Sherdor va Tillakori madrasalari bir-biriga yuzlanib turgan Registon maydoni qaysi shaharda?
gloss: In which city is the Registan, framed by the Ulugh Beg, Sher-Dor and Tilya-Kori madrasas? — Samarkand. Naming the three madrasas rules out Bukhara's own historic Registan square.

text: Ipak qurti qaysi daraxtning barglari bilan oziqlanadi — shuning uchun bu daraxt qishloqlarda koʻp ekilgan?
gloss: Silkworms feed on the leaves of which tree, which is why villages plant so many of them? — The mulberry.

text: Oʻzbek adabiyotidagi ilk roman — «Oʻtkan kunlar»ni kim yozgan?
gloss: Who wrote 'Days Gone By', the first Uzbek novel? — Abdulla Qodiriy (1920s). The others are major Uzbek writers of the same century.

text: Qaysi materikda doimiy aholi yoʻq — u yerda faqat qutb stansiyalaridagi olimlar navbatma-navbat yashaydi?
gloss: Which continent has no permanent population, only scientists at polar stations on rotation? — Antarctica.

text: Kompyuterda belgilangan matnni nusxalash uchun Ctrl tugmasi bilan birga qaysi harf bosiladi?
gloss: To copy selected text, Ctrl plus which letter? — C (copy). V pastes, X cuts, Z undoes: every option is a real shortcut.

text: Qaysi soʻz oxiridan boshiga qarab oʻqilganda ham aynan oʻzi boʻlib qoladi?
gloss: Which word reads the same backwards? — Kiyik (deer): k-i-y-i-k. The others become nuvoq, amlo, iklut.

text: Boksda raqib yiqilib, hakam oʻngacha sanaguncha oʻrnidan tura olmasa, bu nima deyiladi?
gloss: In boxing, if a fallen fighter can't get up before the referee counts ten, what is it called? — A knockout. The others are real sports terms from other games.

text: Bozorda olmaning kilosi 12 000 soʻm. Sotuvchi: «Ikki kilo olsangiz, uchinchisi tekin», — dedi. Uch kilo olma uchun qancha toʻlaysiz?
gloss: Apples cost 12,000 som a kilo; 'buy two, the third is free'. What do three kilos cost? — 24,000 som: you pay for two.

text: Tuyaning oʻrkachida asosan nima toʻplanadi?
gloss: What is mainly stored in a camel's hump? — Fat, not water as many believe; the camel draws energy from it on long trips.

text: Amaki — otaning aka-ukasi, togʻa — onaning aka-ukasi. Onangizning akasining oʻgʻli sizga kim boʻladi?
gloss: Amaki is father's brother, togʻa is mother's brother. Your mother's brother's son is your…? — Togʻavachcha. Xolavachcha (mother's sister's child) is the trap for 'mother's side'.

text: Kristofor Kolumb 1492-yilda qaysi davlat homiyligida Atlantika okeani boʻylab gʻarbga suzib ketgan?
gloss: Under which country's sponsorship did Columbus sail west in 1492? — Spain (the Catholic Monarchs). Traps: he was Genoese (Italy) and first sought backing in Portugal.

text: Navroʻz bahorgi kun-tun tengligida nishonlanadi. Yilning qaysi oyida kun bilan tun yana tenglashadi?
gloss: Navruz is celebrated at the spring equinox. In which month are day and night equal again? — September (autumn equinox, ~22–23 Sept), half a year later. June and December are the solstices.

text: Oʻrta Osiyoning ikki eng katta daryosi — Amudaryo bilan Sirdaryo qaysi suv havzasiga quyiladi?
gloss: Into which body of water do the Amu Darya and Syr Darya flow? — The Aral Sea. The others are the region's other great lakes/seas.

text: Sevimli «Shum bola» filmi qaysi yozuvchining shu nomli qissasi asosida suratga olingan?
gloss: The beloved film 'The Naughty Boy' is based on whose novella of the same name? — Gʻafur Gʻulom.

text: Nintendo oʻyinlarining moʻylovli qahramoni Mario kasbi boʻyicha kim?
gloss: What is the moustached Nintendo hero Mario by trade? — A plumber. 'Carpenter' (his role in the original Donkey Kong) is deliberately left out.

text: Shaxmatda qaysi dona faqat diagonal boʻylab yuradi?
gloss: In chess, which piece moves only diagonally? — The bishop (fil). The king and queen can also move diagonally, but not only.

text: Ota 40 yoshda, oʻgʻli 10 yoshda: ota oʻgʻlidan 4 barobar katta. Necha yildan keyin ota oʻgʻlidan roppa-rosa 3 barobar katta boʻladi?
gloss: Father 40, son 10 (four times older). In how many years will the father be exactly three times older? — 5: 45 = 3 × 15. In 10 years it is only 2.5×.

text: Muchal hisobida 2020-yilda tugʻilgan bola bilan muchali bir xil boʻlgan kishi qaysi yilda tugʻilgan boʻlishi mumkin?
gloss: In the muchal (12-animal) calendar, someone with the same animal as a child born in 2020 could be born in which year? — 2008: the cycle repeats every 12 years (both Rat years).

text: Oʻzbekistonning hech bir qoʻshnisi okeanga chiqa olmaydi. Dunyoda bunday holatdagi yana bitta davlat bor, u Yevropada. Qaysi?
gloss: None of Uzbekistan's neighbours reaches the ocean; one other such country exists, in Europe. Which? — Liechtenstein (neighbours Switzerland and Austria, both landlocked). Andorra and Luxembourg are landlocked but border coastal France, Spain, Belgium.

text: «Alpomish» dostonida qahramon qalmoq yurtiga borib, musobaqalarda gʻolib chiqib, qaysi qizni oʻziga yor qiladi?
gloss: In the epic 'Alpomish', the hero goes to the Kalmyk land, wins the contests and claims which maiden? — Barchinoy. Kumushbibi is from 'Days Gone By', Tomaris a historical queen, Zumrad a fairy-tale girl.

text: Samarqandda rasadxona qurdirgan Mirzo Ulugʻbek Sohibqiron Amir Temurga kim boʻlgan?
gloss: Ulugh Beg, who built the Samarkand observatory, was Timur's…? — Grandson (son of Shahrukh). 'Son' is the trap.

text: Tovush havoda soniyasiga taxminan 340 metr yuradi. Chaqmoq chaqqanidan 3 soniya oʻtib momaqaldiroq eshitildi. Chaqmoq qancha uzoqda chaqqan?
gloss: Sound travels about 340 m per second; thunder came 3 s after the lightning. How far away was it? — About 1 km (3 × 340 = 1,020 m).

text: Oʻzbek lotin alifbosi Z harfi bilan tugamaydi. Undan keyin darhol qaysi harf keladi?
gloss: The Uzbek Latin alphabet doesn't end with Z. Which letter comes right after it? — Oʻ. The official order ends …X, Y, Z, Oʻ, Gʻ, Sh, Ch, ng, ʼ.

text: Qator qanday davom etadi: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, …?
gloss: How does the series continue: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13…? — 17: these are the prime numbers. 15 catches those who see 'odd numbers'.

text: Dunyodagi eng qimmat ziravorni gul ichidagi ingichka qizgʻish iplarni birma-bir qoʻlda terib olishadi. Bu qaysi ziravor?
gloss: The world's most expensive spice is hand-picked thread by thread from inside a flower. Which? — Saffron (crocus stigmas). Vanilla, the second most expensive, is the trap.

text: «Kitob», «maktab» va «kotib» soʻzlari arabcha «yozmoq» maʼnosidagi bitta oʻzakdan. Qaysi soʻz ham shu oilaga kiradi?
gloss: Kitob (book), maktab (school) and kotib (clerk) share one Arabic root meaning 'to write'. Which word belongs too? — Maktub (letter), k-t-b again. Muallim is ʿ-l-m, madrasa d-r-s, maqola q-w-l.

text: Hijriy yil quyosh yilidan taxminan 11 kun qisqa. Shuning uchun Ramazon oyi bizning taqvimda qanday siljiydi?
options: Har yili 11 kunga yaqin kechroq boshlanadi
Har yili 11 kunga yaqin oldinroq boshlanadi
Har yili bir xil sanada boshlanadi
Har toʻrt yilda bir oyga suriladi
gloss: The Hijri year is about 11 days shorter than the solar year. How does Ramadan move in our calendar? — About 11 days earlier each year: a shorter year comes round sooner. 'Later' is the autopilot trap.

text: Telefondagi kulgichlar — «emoji» soʻzi qaysi tildan kelgan?
gloss: Which language does the word 'emoji' come from? — Japanese (e 'picture' + moji 'character'). English is the trap, by its look-alike 'emotion'.

text: Buxorodagi Ismoil Somoniy maqbarasining butun naqshi qaysi materialdan terilgan?
gloss: What is the entire ornament of the Samanid Mausoleum in Bukhara laid out in? — Fired brick (10th century), with no glazed tiles: the patterns come from how the bricks are set.

text: QR-kod 1994-yilda Yaponiyada dastlab qanday maqsadda ixtiro qilingan?
gloss: What was the QR code first invented for in Japan in 1994? — Tracking car parts (Denso Wave, a Toyota group company).

text: Alisher Navoiyning «Muhokamat ul-lugʻatayn» asari nomi «Ikki til muhokamasi» degani. Navoiy unda qaysi ikki tilni qiyoslagan?
gloss: Navoi's 'Judgement of Two Languages' compares which two languages? — Turkic and Persian; he argued Turkic was as fit for poetry as Persian (1499).

text: 2004-yilda Liviyada boʻlib oʻtgan FIDE jahon chempionatida gʻolib chiqqan oʻzbekistonlik shaxmatchi kim?
gloss: Which Uzbek chess player won the 2004 FIDE World Championship in Libya? — Rustam Kasimdzhanov. Abdusattorov (2021 world rapid champion) is the trap.

text: «Algoritm» soʻzi bir olimning nisbasi — tugʻilgan yurtini bildiruvchi nomi — lotinchada buzib aytilganidan kelib chiqqan. Bu olim kim?
gloss: 'Algorithm' comes from the Latin mangling of a scholar's nisba (name from his homeland). Whose? — al-Khwarizmi (Latin 'Algoritmi'). Al-Farghani, whose nisba became 'Alfraganus', is the trap; the sound 'al-gorithm' points to Khwarizmi.

text: Quyosh tizimining qaysi sayyorasida Quyosh gʻarbdan chiqib, sharqqa botadi?
gloss: On which planet does the Sun rise in the west and set in the east? — Venus, which spins backwards. (Uranus, also retrograde, is left out.)

text: Qaysi poytaxt ekvatorga hammasidan yaqin joylashgan?
gloss: Which capital lies closest to the equator? — Quito (~0.2° S); Nairobi ~1.3° S, Bogotá ~4.6° N, Lima ~12° S. The aha: Quito is the capital of Ecuador, whose name means 'equator' (Uzbek Ekvador / ekvator).

text: Bobur Hindistonda asos solgan sulola Yevropada qanday nom bilan mashhur boʻlgan?
gloss: By what name is the dynasty Babur founded in India known in Europe? — The Great Mughals. The others are real neighbouring dynasties of the region.

text: Rimliklar yunon xudolarini oʻzicha atagan: masalan, Germes ular uchun Merkuriy edi. Quyosh tizimidagi eng katta sayyora qaysi yunon xudosining rimcha nomini olgan?
gloss: The Romans renamed Greek gods (Hermes = Mercury). The largest planet bears the Roman name of which Greek god? — Zeus: the largest planet is Jupiter. Kronos = Saturn, Poseidon = Neptune, Ares = Mars.

text: «Yil fasllari» konsertlari muallifi Antonio Vivaldi qaysi shaharda tugʻilgan?
gloss: In which city was Antonio Vivaldi, composer of 'The Four Seasons', born? — Venice, where he spent most of his career.

text: Samarqanddagi Goʻri Amir maqbarasi dastlab Temurning oʻzi uchun emas, boshqa bir temuriy uchun qurila boshlagan. Kim uchun?
gloss: The Gur-e-Amir in Samarkand was first built not for Timur himself but for another Timurid. Whom? — Muhammad Sultan, Timur's grandson and heir, who died in 1403. The others are also connected with the tomb.

text: Dante «Ilohiy komediya»sida doʻzax va aʼrof boʻylab qaysi qadimgi shoir yoʻlboshchilik qiladi?
gloss: In the Divine Comedy, which ancient poet guides Dante through Hell and Purgatory? — Virgil. Homer, Ovid and Horace appear only among the poets in Limbo.

text: Quyosh nuri Yerga taxminan 8 daqiqada yetib keladi. Oy yuzasidan qaytgan yorugʻlik Yergacha qancha vaqtda yetadi?
gloss: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth. How long does moonlight take? — About 1 second: the Moon is ~384,000 km away and light covers ~300,000 km/s. Moonlight is reflected sunlight, which tempts '8 minutes'.

text: Botanik jihatdan qaysi biri haqiqiy rezavor meva hisoblanadi?
gloss: Botanically, which is a true berry? — The banana. The strawberry is an accessory fruit, the raspberry an aggregate of drupelets, the cherry a drupe.

text: «Buyuk Ipak yoʻli» atamasini XIX asrda ilk bor kim fanga kiritgan?
gloss: Who first introduced the term 'Silk Road' in the 19th century? — The German geographer Ferdinand von Richthofen (1877). Marco Polo travelled it but never named it so.

text: Oʻzbekistonning eng baland nuqtasi — Hazrati Sulton choʻqqisi qaysi togʻ tizmasida?
gloss: In which range is Khazret Sultan, Uzbekistan's highest point (4,643 m)? — The Hissar Range, on the Tajik border in Surxondaryo. The others are real ranges of the country.

text: Bir bayt 8 bitdan iborat. Bitta bayt nechta turli qiymatni ifodalay oladi?
gloss: A byte has 8 bits. How many different values can one byte hold? — 256 (2⁸, from 0 to 255). 255, the largest value, is the trap.

text: XI asrda turkiy soʻzlarni arabcha izohlab, «Devonu lugʻotit turk» lugʻatini yaratgan olim kim?
gloss: Who compiled the 11th-century 'Compendium of the Languages of the Turks', explaining Turkic words in Arabic? — Mahmud al-Kashgari. Yusuf Khass Hajib (Kutadgu Bilig) is his contemporary and the main trap.

text: Toshkentda Yangi yil kirib, soat 00:00 ni koʻrsatdi. Xuddi shu lahzada Londonda soat necha boʻladi?
gloss: New Year arrives in Tashkent at 00:00. What time is it in London at that moment? — 19:00 on 31 December: Tashkent is UTC+5, London in winter UTC+0. 05:00 catches those who add instead of subtract.

text: Dengiz sathida suv necha kelvinda qaynaydi?
gloss: At sea level, at how many kelvins does water boil? — 373.15 K: 0 °C = 273.15 K, plus 100. 273.15 K is freezing, 212 is the Fahrenheit boiling point.
